energy_path_audit: ENERGY_PATH_AUDIT: (i) Energy function signature: EBTDefault.forward(embeddings, start_pos) returning a scalar energy for each prediction. The energy function maps 2*(S-1) tokens to their associated energy using a causal-like transformer. (ii) Inference does energy descent via Langevin dynamics/MCMC steps using `torch.autograd.grad(energy, input)` to iteratively adjust input embeddings to minimize energy. The default inference script uses `mcmc_num_steps` = 2 steps for energy descent. (iii) Training objective at a high level: Minimizing the energy of real tokens and maximizing the energy of corrupted tokens (via contrastive loss) combined with a cross-entropy reconstruction loss on predicting the target sequence.
